connector.name: Just Domain
connector.registryDescription: Search domain availability and pricing, straight from chat - then open a link to register.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.justdomain.ai over streamable HTTP. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace ai.justdomain, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.
